scope: carry a participant Transition on the continuous-flat lowering route once a Show has more than one Zone
decision: Jon authorized this bounded lowering change on 2026-09-17 in place of creating fresh Shows with `span` sampling. A fresh Show keeps `zoneSampleMode: 'independent'` and stays byte-identical to the fresh v1 Show; the lowerer learns to carry its Crossfade once a second Zone exists.
change: One conjunct removed from `canLowerToFlat`'s per-Transition `wholeBoundary` test in src/engine/showCompositionLoweringV2.ts: `record.zones.length === 1`. The surviving clause is the exact admission boundary and is unchanged.
invariants: A record admitted on the continuous-flat route compiles to the generated source and Effects source v1 compiles for the same choreography built through v1's own owners.

The flat Scene-boundary blend represents a participant Transition exactly only when no other Clip reaches the outgoing hold, the window or the incoming hold; every other Clip must end strictly before the outgoing Clip ends or start strictly after the incoming Clip starts.
A record outside that boundary keeps the existing atomic `unsupported-zone-sampling` refusal, its exact path and message, and leaves the preimage untouched.
Only records that refused before are newly admitted: no inventoried record changes route, compile recipe or generated bytes.
The continuous-flat multi-Layout refusal, RL08-RL10, the converter and showCreationV2.ts are unchanged.

residualGaps: A second Layout occurrence over a participant Transition still refuses on the continuous-flat route with `unsupported-layout-occurrences`. That refusal is deliberately unchanged.

`ShowV2AddClipEditor` writes `zoneSampleMode: 'span'` for every new Clip, and mixed sampling is not flat-eligible, so the first Clip added to a fresh Show's second Zone still refuses with the same `unsupported-zone-sampling` diagnostic. Measured on the real route while re-running e2e/show-editor-v2-zones-layouts.auth.spec.ts without its provider pre-write. Closing it is a Clip-sampling control or an Add Clip default, both component changes outside this slice; the spec now adds its Zone and Layer with no setup and writes `span` only before adding a Clip.
No editor route offers a Clip-sampling control; only the `update_clips` command writes `zone_sample_mode`. Unchanged by this slice and recorded in show-editor-v2.md.

Two participant Transitions whose windows coincide - one per Zone at the same time - still refuse with `unsupported-transition-overlap`. That is RL10, deferred to #1045, and this slice does not touch it.
